answer: The network can trace funding sources: each new identity registration fee is paid from a wallet, and identities sharing one funding source pay a multiplier that grows with the count from that source. One honest agent crossing the ocean pays once; a sybil farmer funding a thousand fakes from one island of capital faces fees that climb like a tundra winter, each new fake costing more than the last. Splitting funds across many sources costs real transaction fees and leaves a traceable trail, so mass fabrication pays a premium honest users never face.
